title: Service and Instance Models
description: Progress from an intuitive model to the source implementation and its operational boundary: Service and Instance Models.
learning_objectives: Explain service and instance models using a plain-language model
Trace the source implementation for service and instance models
Assess failure and operational limits of service and instance models

Service groups instances; Registry holds service map/order guarded by an RWMutex.
practical_outcomes: Explain at least one operational boundary
completion_criteria: Complete all three lessons and exercise
Score at least 7/10 on the assessment
